5977286227765975151: * Confidential Warning: This document contains highly confidential information on Penacony. Unauthorized distribution will result in severe consequences. I. Incident Background During the second quarter of the first year of AE 2158, a memetic virus known as the "Slumbernana Monkey" spread rapidly in the Dreamscape through images, sounds, and videos. Its impact escalated within the entire Dreamscape and fully covered it in about a week, with its distribution on online platforms manually restricted to evade the IPC's regulation on information. Some affected individuals gradually exhibited symptoms such as hallucinations, delirium, and aphasia. Some severely impacted victims even shifted their intra-cognition to Slumbernana Monkeys, directly influencing their mental state in reality. During this period, dream nurses provided care to affected individuals by focusing on emotion regulation and memory erasure. However, they merely classified the cause of the illness as a common cognitive dissonance symptom, stating, "They're really caught up in their memes," without highlighting any potential risks. II. Incident Details Penacony's Paperfold University was carrying out the Dreamlight Anniversary in the Moment of Sol. All faculty members went to Sunshine Park to conduct academic seminars. During their absence, the Sweet Dreams Troupe specially customized by the Iris Family temporarily took over the teaching and management tasks. Being memetic beings with cognitive abilities, the Sweet Dreams Troupe was also directly affected by the memetic virus and started spreading the virus through teaching, severely infecting a large number of students. Soon, the students who were infected and saw themselves as Slumbernana Monkeys disappeared from the school, presumably transported to other regions of the Dreamscape by the suspect. After the incident lasted a day, the Nameless, who came to participate in the anniversary, and an illegally trespassing Galaxy Ranger intervened, destroying the memetic core of the memetic virus and returning the missing students to campus. However, they refused to provide further information. As a result, the only thing that we know is that the suspect is a member of AtaviSearch Forest, a criminal organization related to Dr. Primitive. According to statements from stowaways recently arrested by the Bloodhound Family, their fleet had encountered "a very, very, very big banana floating in the universe" at the edge of Asdana. If it was not a hallucination caused by memoria allergy, it would most likely have been the ship of the suspect. During the accident, the Bloodhound security guards outside the campus failed to provide any relevant information. After the incident, no relevant information was extracted from their memories, and all the infected students also lost their memories during the infection. This memory loss is currently determined to be unrelated to the memetic virus, and the exact cause is still under investigation. III. Losses Per Penaconian Public Accident Economic Loss Standards, the direct economic loss totaled 11,943,000 Alfalfa credits, mainly for compensating affected merchants selling Slumbernana-Monkey-related merchandises and for follow-up virus elimination. IV. Causes (1) Main Cause: The large-scale criminal organization AtaviSearch Forest specifically produced the memetic virus Slumbernana Monkey against Penacony and released the virus here. The personnel of the relevant departments failed to identify the risks and take effective measures in a timely manner, resulting in the outbreak of the memetic virus. (2) Additional Factors: ① The security department within the Bloodhound Family and its affiliated departments lack a comprehensive security system at dreamers' cognitive level and do not possess the technology to thoroughly screen all information entering the Dreamscape. ② Dream nursing department in the Iris Family lack security awareness and fail to report relevant risks promptly. The Iris Family's Sweet Dreams Troupe system was breached by the suspect and thus lacked security. ③ The Family branches in Penacony failed to promptly take up the responsibilities originally shouldered by the Oak Family, resulting in poor flexibility in some decision-making processes and a deficiency in risk response capabilities. ④ The whereabouts of the suspect and the memetic virus have not been identified so far, potentially indicating surveillance blind spots within the Dreamscape.

Once, she was like an innocent nymph, sheltered by law, draped in flowing finery, basking in sky's dawning light. She danced across the earth, listened to the ocean's songs, followed reason's teachings, slipped past suitors' trickery, untouched by strife or death. Through ever more beautiful passages she wandered, and people supported her in her worldbearing...
Until time took her joy, her beauty, her life, and more. A skeleton lies quietly in a stone coffin. Yet beneath ribs carved like white jade, her heart hasn't withered.
Wipe away the dust from that beautiful heart, and listen... listen to the heartbeat preserved for you.

◆ Trade Plaza Rules ◆
Astral Imageas obtained through Astral Trendible can be traded with Friends in the Trade Plaza.
The Trade Plaza unlocks after obtaining an Astral Imagea and remains permanently open.

◆ Classic Imagea Trade ◆
● Trailblazers can post a "Friend Order" for Classic Edition Chimera and Classic Edition Kitty Furb Imageas in the Trade Plaza, and select the desired Imageas and the Imageas offered for trade in the order. Once the order is posted, Friends can view it in the Trade Plaza.
● Trailblazers can also directly find an order containing their desired Imagea from the "Friend Orders" posted by Friends in the Trade Plaza and confirm the trade. The Trade Plaza displays 6 orders per page, and you can {LAYOUT_MOBILE#tap}{LAYOUT_CONTROLLER#press}{LAYOUT_KEYBOARD#click} the "Refresh" button to refresh the orders.
● Trailblazers can post an "Exclusive Order" to a designated Friend to initiate a targeted trade. After posting the order, only that Friend will receive the order and confirm the trade.
● A Classic Edition Chimera Imagea can only be traded for another Classic Edition Chimera Imagea.
● A Classic Edition Kitty Furb Imagea can only be traded for another Classic Edition Kitty Furb Imagea.

◆ Collector's Edition Imagea Trade ◆
● The Trailblazer can post an "Exclusive Order" for a Collector's Edition Imagea to a designated Friend in the Trade Plaza for a targeted trade. To confirm the trade, the Trailblazer must provide a Collector's Edition Imagea and wait for their friend to also provide a Collector's Edition Imagea.
● A Collector's Edition Chimera Imagea can only be traded for another Collector's Edition Chimera Imagea.
A Collector's Edition Kitty Furb Imagea can only be traded for another Collector's Edition Kitty Furb Imagea.

◆ Order Duration ◆
● When posting a "Friend Order," you can select a duration of 1, 3, or 7 days. When posting an "Exclusive Order," the duration defaults to 7 days. Once the duration expires, incomplete orders will be automatically delisted and the listed Imageas will be refunded to the player.

◆ Trade Order Limits ◆
● The Trailblazer can post a maximum of 6 trade orders at the same time (including "Friend Orders" and "Exclusive Orders"). After an order is completed or recalled, a new trade order can be posted until the limit of 6 is reached.
● The Trailblazer can post a total of up to <unbreak>20</unbreak> trade orders per day (including "Friend Orders" and "Exclusive Orders"). The Trailblazer can accept a total of up to <unbreak>20</unbreak> trade orders per day (including "Friend Orders" and "Exclusive Orders").
● Imageas that are already listed cannot be listed again, nor can they be reclaimed.
● After completing an order, the received Astral Imagea will have a 1-day cooldown time, during which it cannot be listed.

◆ Order Completed ◆
● After an order is completed, the Trailblazer who posted it can claim the corresponding "Friend Order" or "Exclusive Order" in "My Orders." An "Exclusive Order" can also be claimed in chats with Friends.

◆ Privacy Settings ◆
● Trailblazers can choose not to receive "Exclusive Orders" from other Trailblazers in Privacy Settings.
